proposed_urls.rationale: Article 1 - General Provisions: definitions and scope for the lobbying chapter.
Article 2 - Registration: lobbyist and principal registration requirements.
Article 3 - Prohibitions and Restrictions: gift bans, contingency fees, and conduct rules tied to lobbying.
Article 4 - Reporting: lobbyist expenditure and activity reports.
Article 5 - Liaison Personnel: registration/reporting for state-agency liaison personnel.
Article 6 - Violations and Enforcement: penalties and enforcement provisions for the lobbying chapter.
Article 7 - Exemptions: statutory exemptions from registration/reporting under the lobbying chapter.
Article 8 - Miscellaneous: remaining provisions of the lobbying chapter.
